facts.statement: the earliest pair must run by 2026-05-19 and the last by 2026-05-21; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside free regular windows on the calibrated analysers without displacing protected blocks.

options.consequence: rehome series to open windows pairs two release runs in INST-3's free PM window on 2026-05-13 and the other two in INST-2's free AM window on 2026-05-18, so the last run lands 2026-05-18, inside every release window, at no incremental cost.

options.consequence: wait for INST-1 recertification uses its first free window on 2026-05-25 after the 2026-05-22 recertification; it costs nothing but lands 6 days after the control date and pushes every product lot past its 7-day window.
